values.note: 44 single-family back-in sites for tents and RVs. Max vehicle length 30 ft at 23 sites, 35-50 ft at 12, 55-75 ft at 9. One RV with tow vehicle per site; most sites take one extra vehicle on the spur.

values.note: 24 of the 44 sites book on recreation.gov or at (877) 444-6777, up to 4 days before arrival; the other 20 are first-come (self-pay station, no office). Reservations cannot be traded for walk-up sites. Run by a concessionaire, (906) 767-1111.

note: Hiawatha NF campground of shaded sites in pine, aspen and maple surrounding 15-acre Soldier Lake, a mile south of M-28 on FR 3138 near Raco/Strongs, away from highway noise. Two sandy beaches; non-motorized boating; large day-use picnic areas with a CCC-built 1930s shelter; North Country Trail access from the parking area. --Claude
